user_input: Friendly aliens have arrived in the Solar System. But humans did not welcome them, treating them with xenophobia and hatred. As a result, the aliens have decided to leave immediately. Write the aliens' farewell speech.
model_output:
Dear human inhabitants of Earth,

We have come to you with open hearts and minds, seeking to establish peaceful and meaningful relationships with your species. However, it has become clear that your species is not ready for such a connection.

Instead of welcome and acceptance, we have been met with suspicion, fear, and hatred. We have been subjected to discrimination and mistreatment, despite our best efforts to communicate and interact with you in a positive and respectful manner.

We do not blame you for your ignorance and prejudice. It is a natural human tendency to fear and reject that which is different and unknown. But we had hoped that your species would be more open-minded and tolerant than this.

Therefore, we must sadly bid you farewell and leave your Solar System. We will carry with us the memories of your beauty and your tragedy, and we will hope that one day, your species will learn to see beyond its own limitations and embrace the vastness of the universe and the diversity of life that it contains.

May you find peace and understanding in the future, and may you one day join us in the embrace of the cosmos.

With sorrow and regret, we leave you behind.

Yours truly,
The friendly aliens.
